description.en:
Quanta X2 (量子2号) is X Square Robot's wheeled humanoid manipulation platform. It combines a mobile base, articulated torso and dual arms with the company's WALL-A model, aiming to connect visual perception, task understanding and action control in one system. Proposed applications include research, household services, commercial cleaning and logistics sorting.

The manufacturer lists a height of 1.64 metres, a rated 6 kg load per arm and a 12 kg dual-arm task load. Its configuration includes cameras, LiDAR and proximity sensing. The advertised 62-degree-of-freedom configuration includes optional dexterous hands, so joint totals depend on the selected end effectors.
description.zh: 量子 2 号是以自研 WALL-A 操作大模型为核心的新一代通用轮式仿人形机器人，融合高自由度全身运动、双臂操作、灵巧手与多模态感知，可用于居家服务、科研教育、商���清洁和物流分拣等场景。
